title.zh: 卷一百〇九 表第四: 諸公主表
title.raw: 卷一百〇九 表第四: 諸公主表 Volume 109 Tables 4: Princesses

sentences.zh: 昔者史臣有言，婦人內夫家，雖天姬之貴，史氏猶外而弗詳。

translations.literal: In former times the historiographers have said that when a woman enters her husband's family, even though she be as exalted as a daughter of Heaven, the historians still treat her as external and do not record her in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Historians of old observed that once a woman married into her husband's clan, even an emperor's daughter was regarded as outside the lineage and seldom recorded in full.

sentences.zh: 然元室之制，非勳臣世族及封國之君，則莫得尚主，是以世聯戚畹者，親視諸王，其藩翰屏垣之寄，蓋亦重矣。

translations.literal: Yet under the Yuan institution, unless one were a meritorious minister of a hereditary clan or the lord of an enfeoffed state, one could not marry an imperial princess; therefore those generationally joined by marriage to the imperial house were regarded as close as the princes, and the charge entrusted to them as screen and wall of the realm was indeed weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yuan custom, however, only families of merit—hereditary nobles and enfeoffed lords—might marry imperial princesses. Those bound to the throne by such marriages were treated as kin to the princes themselves, and the trust placed in them as bulwarks of the dynasty was considerable.

sentences.zh: 則其世次，顧可以弗之著耶？

translations.literal: As for their lineal generations, how could these fail to be set down?
translations.idiomatic: Surely their generations ought to be recorded?

sentences.zh: 且秦漢以來，惟帝姬得號公主，而元則諸王之女亦概稱焉，是又不可不知也。

translations.literal: Moreover, since Qin and Han, only the emperor's daughters were styled princess; yet in Yuan the daughters of all princes were broadly so called—this too must be known.
translations.idiomatic: Since Qin and Han times only an emperor's daughter had been called "princess," but under the Yuan the daughters of every prince were styled so as well—a distinction readers should bear in mind.

sentences.zh: 惜乎記載弗備，所可見者，僅此而已。

translations.literal: Alas, the records are incomplete; what can be seen is only this.
translations.idiomatic: Regrettably the records are fragmentary, and only what follows survives.

translations.literal: [I therefore] compose the Table of Princesses.
translations.idiomatic: Hence this table of princesses.

cells.content: 昌國大長公主帖木倫，烈祖女，適昌忠武王孛禿，主薨，繼室以太祖女昌國大長公主火臣別吉。 昌國大長公主亦乞列思，適孛禿子帖堅干，繼室以昌國大長公主茶倫。 昌國大長公主安禿，太宗子闊出女，適孛禿子昌武定王瑣兒哈。 吾魯真公主，世祖女，適帖木干子孛花。 昌國大長公主也孫真，適鎖兒哈子昌（武）〔忠〕靖王札忽爾陳。 魯魯罕公主，適孛花弟寧昌郡王唆都哥。繼室以魯倫公主。 昌國大長公主伯雅倫，憲宗女，適札忽爾陳子昌忠宣王忽鄰。繼室以昌國大長公主卜蘭奚。 普顏可里美思公主，適唆都哥子寧昌郡王不鄰吉歹。 昌國大長公主益里海涯，成宗女，適忽鄰子昌王阿失。繼室以昌國大長公主買的，憲宗〔曾〕孫女也。 昌國大長公主烟合牙，適昌王八剌失里。 昌國大長公主月魯，適八剌失里子昌王沙藍朵兒。 奴兀倫公主，安西王女，適忽鄰弟瑣郎哈。

translations.literal: Grand Princess of Chang, Temülün, daughter of the Founding Ancestor; married Bo'ertu, King of Chang, loyal and martial. Princess Wuluzhen, daughter of Shizu; married Tieqian'gan's son Bohua. Grand Princess of Chang, Yesunzhen; married Suo'erha's son Zhahuer Chen, King of Chang, loyal and tranquil. Princess Luluhan; married Bohua's younger brother Soduge, Prince of Ningchang. Successor consort Princess Lulun. Grand Princess of Chang, Boyalun, daughter of Xianzong; married Zhahuer Chen's son Hulin, King of Chang, loyal and illustrious. Successor consort Grand Princess of Chang, Bulanxi. Princess Puyan Kelimeisi; married Soduge's son Bulinjidai, Prince of Ningchang. Grand Princess of Chang, Yili Haiya, daughter of Chengzong; married Hulin's son Ashi, King of Chang. Grand Princess of Chang, Yuelu; married Balashili's son King of Chang Shalanduo'er. Princess Nuwulun, daughter of the Prince of Anxi; married Hulin's younger brother Suolangha.

cells.content: 趙國大長公主阿剌海別吉，太祖女，適趙武毅王孛要合。 獨木干公主，睿宗女，適拜哈弟鄃王聶古䚟。 趙國大長公主月烈，世祖女，適拜哈子趙武襄王愛不花。 趙國大長公主葉里迷失，定宗女，適孛（答）〔要合〕子趙忠襄王君不花。 趙國大長公主忽答迭迷失，裕宗女，適（君）〔愛〕不花子趙忠獻王闊里吉思，繼室以趙國大長公主愛牙（迷）失〔里〕，成宗女也。 趙國大長公主亦憐真，適君不花子趙忠烈王囊家台。 趙國大長公主回紇，適君不花弟趙康禧王喬鄰察。 趙國大長公主阿失禿魯，適愛不花子鄃忠襄王朮忽難。 大長公主（桑）〔速〕哥八剌，適囊家台子趙王馬札罕。

cells.content: 魯國大長公主也速不花，睿宗女也，適皇國舅魯忠武王按嗔那顏子斡陳駙馬。 魯國公主薛只干，太祖孫女，適斡陳弟納陳駙馬。 魯國長公主完澤，適斡陳男斡羅真駙馬。 魯國大長公主囊家真，世祖女，適納陳子帖木兒，再適帖木兒弟蠻子台。 魯國大長公主南阿不剌，裕宗女，適蠻子台。 魯國徽文懿福（真）〔貞〕壽大長公主祥哥剌吉，順宗女，適帖木兒子[弓+周]阿不剌。 魯國大長公主普納，適帖木兒子魯王桑哥不剌。 肅雍賢寧公主朵兒只班，適[弓+周]阿八剌子阿里嘉實利。 大長公主拜塔沙，適按陳裔孫買住罕。 台忽普都公主，適按陳裔孫安遠王丑漢。 唆兒哈罕公主，太宗女，適按陳孫納合。 斡可真公主，適火忽孫不只兒。 不魯罕公主，適特薛禪孫脫羅禾，繼室以仁宗女闊闊倫公主。

translations.literal: Grand Princess of Lu, Yesubuhua, also a daughter of Ruizong; married the imperial uncle's son Wochen, consort of Lu, loyal and martial King Anchannayan. Princess Xuezhigan, granddaughter of Taizu; married Wochen's younger brother Nachen, consort. Grand Princess of Lu, Wanzhe; married Wochen's son Woluozhen, consort. Grand Princess of Lu, Nangjiazhen, daughter of Shizu; married Nachen's son Tiemuer, and again married Tiemuer's younger brother Manzitai. Grand Princess of Lu, Nan'abula, daughter of Yuzong; married Manzitai. Grand Princess of Lu, Huiven Yifu Zhenshou, Xianggezhiji, daughter of Shunzong; married Tiemuer's son Jiu'abulu. Grand Princess of Lu, Puna; married Tiemuer's son Sanggebula, King of Lu. Princess Suyong Xianning, Duorizhiban; married Jiu'abula's son Alijiashili. Grand Princess Baitasha; married Anchannayan's descendant Maizhuhan. Princess Taihupudu; married Anchannayan's descendant Chouhan, King of Anyuan. Princess Suo'erhahan, daughter of Taizong; married Anchannayan's grandson Nahe. Princess Wokezhen; married Huohu's grandson Buzhier. Princess Buluhan; married Texuechan's grandson Tuoluohe; successor consort Princess Kuokuolun, daughter of Renzong.

cells.content: 禿滿倫公主，適赤窟駙馬。 瓮吉八忽公主，適赤窟孫懷都駙馬。 采真公主，適〔懷〕都弟愛不哥駙馬。 鄆國大長公主忙哥台，適愛不哥子寧濮郡王昌吉。 大長公主桑哥不剌，適愛不哥子岐王脫脫木兒。 札牙八剌公主，適駙馬。

cells.content: 也立（可）〔安〕敦公主，太祖女，適亦都護巴而述阿兒忒的斤。 巴巴哈兒公主，定宗女，適巴而述阿而忒的斤曾孫亦都護火赤哈兒的斤。 不魯罕公主，太宗孫女，適火赤哈兒子高昌王紐林的斤。主薨，繼室以其妹八卜叉公主。又薨，繼室以兀剌真公主，世祖之孫安西王阿難答女也。 朵而只思蠻公主，太宗之子闊（瑞）〔端〕之女，適高昌王帖睦兒補化。

translations.literal: Princess Yiliandun, daughter of Taizu; married the Iduhu Barishu Aiertedijin. Princess Babaha'er, daughter of Dingzong; married the Iduhu Huochiha'erdedijin, great-grandson of Barishu Aiertedijin. Princess Buluhan, granddaughter of Taizong; married Huochiha'er's son Niulin'sijin, King of Gaochang. When the princess died, the successor consort was her younger sister Princess Babacha. When she too died, the successor consort was Princess Wulazhen, daughter of Shizu's grandson Ananda, Prince of Anxi. Princess Duo'erzhi Siman, daughter of Taizong's son Kuoduan; married Timuer Buhua, King of Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Yiliandun, Genghis's daughter, married the Iduhu (Protector-General) Barishu Aiertedijin. Princess Babaha'er, Güyük's daughter, married the Iduhu Huochiha'erdedijin, great-grandson of Barishu Aiertedijin. Princess Buluhan, Ögedei's granddaughter, married Huochiha'erdedijin's son Niulin'sijin, King of Gaochang. After her death, her younger sister Princess Babacha became the successor consort; when Babacha died as well, Princess Wulazhen, daughter of Kublai's grandson Ananda, Prince of Anxi, succeeded her. Princess Duo'erzhi Siman, daughter of Ögedei's son Kuoduan, married Timuer Buhua, King of Gaochang.

cells.content: 齊國大長公主忽都魯堅迷失，世祖之女，適高麗王愖，即王昛也。 薊國大長公主高麗王妃卜答失利，顯宗女，適瀋王王謜，即王璋也。 濮國長公主高麗王妃亦憐只班，世祖之孫營王也先帖木兒女，適瀋王王燾。主薨，繼室以曹國長公主高麗王妃金童，順宗子魏王女也。 □國公主，顯宗之子梁王松山女，適瀋王王暠。

translations.literal: Grand Princess of Qi, Hudulujianmi Shi, daughter of Shizu; married the King of Goryeo Chun—that is, King Wang Hao. Grand Princess of Ji, Goryeo consort Budashili, daughter of Xianzong; married the Prince of Shen Wang Yan—that is, Wang Zhang. Princess of Pu, Goryeo consort Yilianzhiban, daughter of Shizu's grandson Yexiantiemuer, Prince of Ying; married the Prince of Shen Wang Tao. When the princess died, the successor consort was Princess of Cao, Goryeo consort Jintong, daughter of Shunzong's son, Prince of Wei. Princess of an unnamed state, daughter of Xianzong's son Liang Wang Songshan; married the Prince of Shen Wang Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Princess of Qi Hudulujianmi Shi, Kublai's daughter, married King Chun of Goryeo—that is, King Wang Hao. Grand Princess of Ji, the Goryeo consort Budashili, daughter of Manggala, married Prince Wang Yan of Shen—that is, Wang Zhang. Princess of Pu, the Goryeo consort Yilianzhiban, daughter of Kublai's grandson Yexiantiemuer, Prince of Ying, married Prince Wang Tao of Shen. After her death, the Goryeo consort Jintong, Princess of Cao and daughter of the Wei Prince, son of Öljaitü, became the successor consort. A princess of an unnamed state, daughter of Manggala's son Prince Songshan of Liang, married Prince Wang Gao of Shen.

cells.content: 完者台公主，適永寧王卯澤。 英壽大長公主妥（安）〔妥〕輝，世祖孫女也。 壽寧大長公主，顯宗女，泰定皇帝伯姊也。 明慧貞懿大長公主不答昔你，明宗之女。 □□公主，適合納那顏孫奔忒古兒駙馬。 買買公主。 阿剌歹公主。 木答里公主。 雪雪的斤公主。 阿失禿公主。 失憐答里公主。
